# Torch constraint for CPU-only hosts (no NVIDIA GPU).
# Pins the CPU torch build so an extras install can't pull a large CUDA wheel you
# can't use. See constraints-cu124.txt for the full rationale.
#
#     pip install torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
#     pip install -e ".[local]" -c constraints-cpu.txt

--extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu

torch==2.6.0
torchvision==0.21.0
torchaudio==2.6.0
